**Save spec to** `.handoffs/vega-sprint-9-spec.md`:

## 1. Payments list (`/payments`)
`<DataTable>` — columns: date, client, artist, amount (tabular-nums), method, status. Filter drawer (Sheet right) for date range, amount range, status, method. Status pills use semantic tokens. Refund modal with type-name confirm for >$500. Invoice preview drawer (Sheet right) with PDF render. Receipt email resend button.

## 2. Commissions (`/commissions`)

### 2.1 Tabs: Records | Rules | Disputes | Leaderboard | Adjustments

### 2.2 Records tab
`<DataTable>` of commission rows per appointment. Expandable row showing calculation breakdown.

### 2.3 Rules tab
Rule editor as config form (not formula builder). 3 preset cards ("Flat %", "Tiered by revenue", "Custom"). Live preview calculator sidebar — "If I apply this rule to a $X appointment by artist Y, they earn $Z".

### 2.4 Disputes tab
Drawer with comment thread. Resolve/Reject actions. Timeline of comments. Status pill.

### 2.5 Leaderboard tab
Top 10 earners month/quarter/year. Each row: rank, avatar, name, revenue sparkline, total.

### 2.6 Adjustments tab
Manual +/- with reason. Audit log. Apply to specific payroll run.

## 3. Payroll (`/payroll/*`)

### 3.1 Runs list (`/payroll`)
`<DataTable>` of runs with status pill (draft/review/approved/paid/failed). Row click → run detail.

### 3.2 Run detail (`/payroll/runs/[id]`)
Visual 5-step stepper: Draft → Review → Approve → Pay → Complete. Current step highlighted. Locked steps show checkmark.
Per-artist rows (expandable): artist name, hours/sessions count, gross, deductions, net. Editable in Draft state only.

### 3.3 Tax forms (`/payroll/tax-forms/[id]`)
react-pdf viewer in a drawer. Download button. "Re-request W-9" action if stale. PII-safe: server-side only signed URL for download.

### 3.4 Artist summaries (`/payroll/artist-summaries/[id]`)
Per-artist total earnings per period. PDF download for 1099-K prep.

### 3.5 CSV export
Button on runs list. Generates CSV with all paid runs in date range.

## 4. Tenant billing (`/settings/billing`)

### 4.1 Plan comparison table
4 columns: Solo / Studio / Pro / Enterprise. Current plan highlighted with a ring. Upgrade / Downgrade CTAs.

### 4.2 Usage meters
Bookings, AI credits, SMS, seats. Color thresholds: green (<70%), amber (70-90%), red (>90%).

### 4.3 Invoice history
`<DataTable>` of invoices. PDF download per row.

### 4.4 Payment method swap
Dodo Customer Portal link (hosted).

### 4.5 Cancel flow
3-step Notion-style:
- Step 1: "What's making you want to cancel?" — survey
- Step 2: Retention offer (pause subscription, discount)
- Step 3: Final confirm with end-of-billing-period warning

## 5. Admin billing (`/admin/billing`)

### 5.1 MRR dashboard
Stacked area chart (Recharts) — color-coded by plan tier. Click-drag to zoom time range. Double-click reset. Click tooltip → drawer with that day's subscription events.

### 5.2 KPI row
4 KpiCards: New MRR, Expansion, Contraction, Churned — each with mini-sparkline + MoM delta.

### 5.3 Failed payments alert
Top banner if active failures. List below: client, amount, retry count, next retry.

### 5.4 Churn cohort grid
Monthly cohorts × retention month heatmap. Darker cell = lower retention.

### 5.5 LTV distribution
Histogram of customer lifetime values. Median line.

## 6. Database
- Verify `commission_rules` flexibility — config-form (not formula) shape stored as jsonb per Nova
- Verify payroll state machine fields exist (`status`, `approved_by`, `approved_at`, `paid_at`)
- Audit trail table for commission adjustments + manual overrides

## 7. Security (PII + tax compliance)
- Tax form viewing gated to Owner/Admin + logs to `audit_log`
- PDF URLs signed with 5-min expiry
- W-9 raw data encrypted at rest (verify existing migration)
- Commission adjustments require `reason` field, attributed in audit log

## 8. `/dev/design` updates
- Section 17: Commission rule preview calculator
- Section 18: Payroll stepper in isolation
- Section 19: MRR chart demo (Recharts)

## 9. Acceptance
```bash
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint --max-warnings=0 && pnpm build
```
Plus: payroll draft-to-paid flow end-to-end, commission recalculates in real-time as rules change, MRR dashboard sums match active subs (verify in demo data), Dodo refund + receipt resend work in test mode.

Mechanical spec, no design decisions for Koda.

1	# Nova — Sprint 9 Competitor Benchmark: Money Flows (Payments / Commissions / Payroll / Billing)
2	
3	**Target:** InkOS multi-tenant tattoo studio SaaS. Scope: payments list + refunds, commission rules/records/disputes, payroll runs with tax forms, tenant-facing billing, admin-facing MRR/churn dashboard.
4	**Benchmarked:** Stripe Dashboard (dashboard.stripe.com), QuickBooks Online, Pilot.com, Gusto, Rippling, Mercury (mercury.com), ProfitWell/Baremetrics (admin MRR references).
5	
6	---
7	
8	## Part 1 — Payment List
9	
10	### Columns (Stripe Dashboard is the gold standard)
11	Stripe's Payments table: **Amount · Status (chip) · Description · Customer · Date · Payment method (brand + last 4) · Actions (·••)**. Sticky first column (amount), right-aligned currency, monospaced amount font, status as colored dot + text (`succeeded` green, `refunded` gray, `disputed` red, `pending` amber). [Source: dashboard.stripe.com/payments]
12	
13	Mercury's Transactions table drops "Description" and adds **Counterparty** + **Category** — cleaner for banking context but less useful for us. QuickBooks adds **Memo** and **Class** columns — too accounting-heavy.
14	
15	**InkOS columns:** Amount · Status · Client · Artist · Booking / Service · Method (Card/Cash/Zelle/Cashapp) · Date · Actions. Monospace amount. Tabular-nums on dates. Click row → opens drawer (not page — Stripe pattern).
16	
17	### Filter drawer
18	Stripe uses a **right-side slide-in drawer** with sections: Date range (preset pills + custom), Status (multi-checkbox), Amount (min/max), Payment method, Currency, Customer search. "Clear all" + "Apply" sticky footer. Saved views across top of table ("All", "Succeeded today", "Refunded this month"). [Source: stripe.com/docs/dashboard]
19	
20	Mercury uses **inline filter chips** above table — simpler but caps out at ~5 filters.
21	
22	**InkOS:** Copy Stripe's drawer pattern exactly. Sections: Date range, Status, Amount range, Method, Artist (for multi-artist studios), Client search. Saved views: "Today", "This week", "Pending deposits", "Refunds", "Disputed". Filter state persists in URL for sharing.
23	
24	### Refund flow
25	Stripe's refund is a **modal, not a drawer**: amount field (prefilled full amount, editable for partial), reason dropdown (`duplicate`/`fraudulent`/`requested_by_customer`/`other`), internal note field, destructive red confirm button showing **"Refund $X to •••• 4242"** — the last-4 confirmation prevents mistakes. Optimistic UI flips row to `refunded` immediately, rolls back on API error. [Source: dashboard.stripe.com refund modal]
26	
27	**InkOS:** Same modal. Add "Restock deposit-used inventory?" checkbox (tattoo-specific — if a needle/ink cartridge was counted against the booking). Require typed client name for full refunds >$200 (safety gate). Auto-void commission record on full refund, show "Commission of $X also reversed" inline.
28	
29	### Invoice preview drawer
30	QuickBooks uses a **right-side drawer** with full invoice rendered as PDF preview + "Download PDF" + "Send again" + "Mark paid" buttons. Stripe shows a **hosted invoice URL** inline with a live preview iframe. [Source: quickbooks.intuit.com/learn-support]
31	
32	**InkOS:** Drawer with three tabs: **Preview** (rendered invoice HTML), **History** (sent/opened/paid events timeline), **Actions** (Resend · Download PDF · Edit memo · Void). Mirror Stripe's "Pay this invoice" public link for clients who can't find the email.
33	
34	### Receipt resend
35	Stripe ships a tiny "Resend receipt" button that opens a one-field modal (email, prefilled with customer email). Success toast: "Receipt sent to foo@bar.com". No back-end drama. **Copy verbatim.** Add SMS resend option for InkOS (clients often book by phone, no email).
36	
37	---
38	
39	## Part 2 — Commission Rules
40	
41	### Formula builder vs config
42	Rippling's **compensation rules** use a **config form** (not formula builder): dropdowns for "Pay type: Hourly/Salary/Commission", "Rate: %", "Applied to: Revenue/Profit/Tips". Simple, no free-form math. [Source: rippling.com/payroll]
43	
44	Gusto uses **plain config + custom earnings types** — admin creates an "Earning" called "Commission" with a flat % or fixed amount. No conditional logic.
45	
46	QuickBooks Payroll has a **rule builder**: IF (service category = X) THEN (commission = Y%). Closer to what InkOS needs but it's buried in settings.
47	
48	**InkOS recommendation:** **Config form, not formula builder** — 90% of studios use one of three patterns: (a) flat % of service revenue, (b) tiered % (50% up to $5k/week, 60% after), (c) split (60% artist / 40% studio, supplies deducted first). Build a **preset picker** (3 cards) + "Custom tier" editor. No free-form formulas — that's Rippling's lesson: complexity deters adoption.
49	
50	Config fields: Scope (per artist / studio default), Base (% of service · % of service+tip · flat $ per appointment), Deductions (supplies at cost / supplies at markup / none), Tier breakpoints (optional, up to 3 tiers), Effective date.
51	
52	### Preview calculator
53	Pilot.com's bookkeeping rules have a **"Test this rule"** sidebar — paste a sample transaction, see computed output before saving. Stripe Tax has similar "Preview tax for example charge". [Source: pilot.com/product]
54	
55	**InkOS:** Right rail **"Preview calculator"** always visible on commission rule edit page. Inputs: Service price, Tip, Supplies cost. Outputs live: Artist earns $X · Studio keeps $Y · Breakdown table (base, tip split, deductions). Updates on every keystroke. Reduces support tickets.
56	
57	### Disputes comment thread
58	Gusto's **payroll disputes** use a **threaded comment panel** on the specific line item — artist clicks "Flag this" → modal with reason + comment → admin sees notification → reply-thread in panel (like a Notion comment thread). Resolved flag hides from default view but stays auditable. [Source: gusto.com/product/payroll]
59	
60	Linear's comment pattern is the purest UI reference (threaded, markdown, @mentions).
61	
62	**InkOS:** On each commission record, "View · Flag · History". Flag opens a **side panel** with: Reason dropdown (Wrong rate / Missed tip / Duplicate / Refund not applied / Other), Comment box, Attach evidence (screenshot). Admin sees unread badge in sidebar. Threaded replies. Resolution requires "Accept · Reject · Adjust" action — adjustments create a correcting entry (never edit the original — audit law).
63	
64	### Leaderboard
65	Gusto ships a **"Top earners this period"** card on payroll dashboard. Fresha has an **artist leaderboard** widget (revenue, appointments, retention). [Source: fresha.com]
66	
67	**InkOS:** Leaderboard tab on Commissions page. Columns: Rank · Artist · Services revenue · Tips · Commission earned · YoY delta. Filters: This week / month / quarter / YTD. Gamification done tastefully — medal icons for top 3, no shame for bottom. Toggle "Private mode" (owner-only) vs "Visible to all artists" (studio culture choice).
68	
69	---
70	
71	## Part 3 — Payroll Runs
72	
73	### State machine
74	Gusto's payroll runs: **Draft → Review → Approve → Processing → Paid**, with **"Submit by X for pay date Y"** countdown banner. [Source: gusto.com/product/payroll] Rippling uses same states + "Correction" state for amendments.
75	
76	**InkOS states:** `draft` (editable) → `review` (frozen numbers, comment-open) → `approved` (owner signed off) → `processing` (payouts initiated) → `paid` (all payouts confirmed) → `closed` (immutable, 7-year retention). Rejection from review → back to draft with reason.
77	
78	### Visual stepper
79	Gusto uses a **horizontal stepper at top of page**: 5 dots with labels, current step filled, completed checked, future gray. Click completed steps to view read-only. [Source: gusto.com payroll run flow]
80	
81	**InkOS:** Horizontal stepper (desktop), vertical on mobile. 5 steps: **1. Calculate → 2. Review → 3. Approve → 4. Pay → 5. Close**. Current step pulses (soft glow using `--color-electric-purple`). Step-blockers shown as red dot with tooltip ("2 disputes unresolved").
82	
83	### Per-artist summaries
84	Gusto's payroll page shows **one expandable row per employee**: collapsed = name + gross + net; expanded = line items (regular hours, OT, commission, tip, pre-tax deductions, taxes, post-tax, net). [Source: gusto.com]
85	
86	**InkOS:** One row per artist. Collapsed columns: Avatar · Name · Services · Commission · Tips · Gross · Deductions · **Net** (bold, monospace). Expand reveals: line-item table (all bookings), tip allocation, supplies deducted, adjustments, tax withholding (for W-2) / 1099 totals (for contractors). Inline comment thread per row.
87	
88	### Tax form viewer (1099-K, W-9)
89	Gusto's tax forms live at `/taxes/forms` — table of forms with status (Draft / Finalized / Filed / Delivered). Click row → PDF viewer in drawer with "Download", "Send to artist", "Re-file" actions. [Source: gusto.com/taxes]
90	
91	QuickBooks has the same pattern + **"eFile with IRS"** button.
92	
93	**InkOS:** Tax forms tab under Payroll. Split sections: **Artist forms** (1099-NEC for contractors, W-2 for employees, W-9 on file check) and **Studio forms** (1099-K received from Dodo/Stripe, quarterly estimated, annual summary). Inline PDF viewer (react-pdf) in drawer. "Send secure link to artist" instead of email attachment (PII safety). Status chips: Draft / Ready to file / Filed / Delivered / Amended.
94	
95	Encryption note: W-9 SSN fields must be encrypted at rest (Supabase pgcrypto + column-level RLS). Mask as `•••-••-1234` in UI; reveal requires re-auth + audit log entry. (Already covered in Sprint 12 hardening but Sprint 9 must stub the storage.)
96	
97	### CSV export
98	Stripe's "Export" button opens a modal: Date range, Columns to include (multi-check), Format (CSV/JSON), Delivery (Download now / Email when ready). For >10k rows it queues + emails. [Source: dashboard.stripe.com/exports]
99	
100	**InkOS:** Same pattern. Presets: "Payroll for accountant" (artist, period, gross, tax, net), "Commission detail" (every line), "IRS 1099 export". Export queued via BullMQ; email link when ready. Signed URL, 24h expiry.
101	
102	---
103	
104	## Part 4 — Tenant Billing
105	
106	### Plan comparison table
107	Linear's pricing page has **3-column table with feature rows + checkmarks**, current plan highlighted with purple ring, "Upgrade" CTA per column. [Source: linear.app/pricing] Notion uses same pattern + **annual/monthly toggle**.
108	
109	**InkOS:** 4 columns (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199). Rows: Artists included, Bookings/mo, Storage, AI design credits, Multi-location, SSO, Support SLA. Current plan highlighted with `--color-electric-purple` ring + "Current plan" badge. Grayed-out columns for downgrades (require cancel-survey).
110	
111	### Usage meters with thresholds
112	Vercel's billing page shows **horizontal progress bars** per metered resource: Bandwidth, Function invocations, Build minutes. Bar fills green → amber at 75% → red at 90%. [Source: vercel.com/docs/billing]
113	
114	Mercury uses **ring meters** on dashboard for card spend limits.
115	
116	**InkOS:** Horizontal progress bars (Vercel model) on Billing page. Meters: Artists used (4 of 5), Bookings this month (234 of 500), AI credits (48 of 100), Storage (2.1 GB of 10 GB). Colors: `< 75%` neutral, `75–90%` amber, `> 90%` red. "Upgrade" inline CTA appears at 80%.
117	
118	### Invoice history
119	Stripe's customer portal: **table with Date · Invoice # · Amount · Status (Paid/Open/Void) · PDF download icon**. [Source: stripe.com/docs/billing/customer/customer-portal] Mercury identical pattern.
120	
121	**InkOS:** Copy Stripe customer portal verbatim. Columns: Date · Invoice # · Amount · Status · PDF. Click row → hosted invoice page (Dodo provides). "Download all (ZIP)" bulk action for accountant handoff.
122	
123	### Payment method swap
124	Stripe portal: **Default card + "Add new card" + "Delete"** on non-default cards. Adding card uses Stripe Elements inline — no redirect. [Source: stripe.com/docs/payments/save-and-reuse]
125	
126	**InkOS:** Dodo's equivalent hosted flow. UI: card brand icon · last 4 · exp · default badge · "Make default" / "Remove". "Add payment method" opens Dodo-hosted modal. Never touch card numbers directly (PCI scope zero).
127	
128	### Cancel-with-retention
129	Notion and Linear both use a **3-step cancel flow**: Step 1 reason survey (radio: too expensive / missing features / switching / other), Step 2 **targeted retention offer** (50% off 3 months / downgrade to cheaper plan / pause subscription), Step 3 confirm. [Source: notion.so cancel flow]
130	
131	Baremetrics data: 15–25% of cancels are saved by a good retention step. Worth building.
132	
133	**InkOS:** Same 3-step pattern. Reason survey → conditional offer (too expensive → 30% for 3mo; missing feature → book call with Yash; switching → export-my-data + pause; other → direct cancel). Pause = 90 days free, read-only access, no data deletion. Confirm requires typing studio name.
134	
135	---
136	
137	## Part 5 — Admin Billing
138	
139	### MRR dashboard
140	Baremetrics/ProfitWell set the bar: **Big hero number** (current MRR with MoM delta), then **line chart** (90-day MRR), then **breakdown cards** (New · Expansion · Contraction · Churn · Reactivation). Color scheme: green gains, red losses. [Source: baremetrics.com/demo, profitwell.com]
141	
142	Mercury's account balance graph is the closest **UI reference** — clean line, hover shows tooltip with date + value, time-range pills (7D / 30D / 90D / YTD / All). [Source: mercury.com dashboard]
143	
144	**InkOS:** Admin `/admin/billing` hero: MRR $XX,XXX (+12.4% MoM, green arrow). Below: 4 stat cards (New MRR, Expansion, Contraction, Churned). Below: line chart with Mercury-style time pills. Stacked bar option for "MRR by plan" breakdown.
145	
146	### ARR projection
147	ProfitWell shows ARR = MRR × 12 with a **12-month projection** line extrapolated from last 3 months growth rate. Confidence band (light shaded area) shows ±10% range. [Source: profitwell.com metrics]
148	
149	**InkOS:** Stat card "ARR (projected)" = current MRR × 12. Dotted-line extension on the main chart showing next 90 days projection. Small disclaimer "Based on trailing 90-day growth".
150	
151	### Failed payments
152	Stripe's Dashboard has a **"Failed payments" table** with Reason code (insufficient funds, expired card, 3DS challenge), Retry count, Next retry, Dunning email status. Bulk "Retry all" action. [Source: dashboard.stripe.com]
153	
154	**InkOS:** Table at `/admin/billing/failed-payments`. Columns: Studio · Amount · Reason · Attempt # · Next retry · Email sent? · Action (Retry now / Contact). Auto-retry schedule: 1d / 3d / 7d. After 3 fails → subscription state `past_due`; after 14 days → `suspended` (read-only).
155	
156	### Churn cohorts
157	ProfitWell's **retention curve chart**: X-axis months since signup, Y-axis % retained, one line per cohort (Jan signups, Feb signups...). [Source: profitwell.com] Exposes whether retention is improving over time.
158	
159	**InkOS:** Cohort heatmap table. Rows = signup month, columns = months since signup, cell = % retained (color-scaled green→red). Plus a single-chart overlay version for top 6 cohorts.
160	
161	### LTV distribution
162	Baremetrics shows LTV as a **histogram + median marker**. Bins of $100 buckets. [Source: baremetrics.com/metrics] Most LTV dashboards just show an average, which hides a long tail.
163	
164	**InkOS:** Histogram on `/admin/billing` → LTV tab. X-axis $ buckets, Y-axis count. Median and p90 markers as vertical dashed lines. Summary: Mean LTV, Median LTV, Payback period (months), LTV:CAC ratio (if CAC tracked).
165	
166	---
167	
168	## Part 6 — Three Replica Notes
169	
170	### Replica 1: Stripe Payments drawer
171	Click any payment row → right-side drawer slides in (450px wide, `--color-ink-black` surface with subtle backdrop blur).
172	
173	**Header:** Status chip (colored dot + text) · Amount XX-large monospace · Close X.
174	**Metadata grid (2-col):** ID · Date · Method (card brand + •••• 4242) · Client · Artist · Booking ID (linked).
175	**Timeline:** Vertical event list (Created → Auth → Captured → Succeeded / Refunded / Disputed), each with timestamp and actor.
176	**Actions bar (sticky footer):** Refund · Resend receipt · Copy ID · Dispute info (if applicable).
177	**Related records:** Booking link + Commission record link (expandable mini-cards).
178	
179	Animation: drawer slides in 200ms ease-out, content fades 100ms after. Close on Escape or backdrop click.
180	
181	### Replica 2: Gusto payroll approval
182	Single-page flow at `/payroll/runs/[id]/approve`:
183	
184	**Top:** 5-step stepper (currently on step 3 "Approve").
185	**Summary card:** Pay period · Total gross · Total net · Total taxes · # of artists · Process date.
186	**Table:** Expandable rows per artist (collapsed shows Name + Net; expand shows line items).
187	**Warnings panel** (right rail, amber): "2 artists have unresolved disputes", "1 artist missing W-9 — block until uploaded".
188	**Approval gate (bottom):** Checkbox "I confirm these amounts are correct" + typed confirmation "Type APPROVE to continue" + primary CTA button (disabled until both).
189	**After approve:** Confetti-free success (tattoo studio owners are not Notion users) — just a clean toast "Payroll approved. Payouts scheduled for Friday." + redirect to run detail page in `processing` state.
190	
191	### Replica 3: Mercury MRR graph
192	Hero card on `/admin/billing`:
193	
194	**Top-left:** Label "MRR" (small caps, muted) · value `$47,320` (3xl, tabular-nums) · delta chip `+12.4% MoM` (green bg, rounded-full).
195	**Top-right:** Time-range pills (7D / 30D / **90D** / YTD / All) — active pill has `--color-electric-purple` ring.
196	**Chart:** Single line, 2px stroke, `--color-electric-purple` gradient fill fading to transparent (Mercury aesthetic). Smooth cubic-bezier, not jagged. Hover: crosshair + tooltip card with date + exact MRR.
197	**Below chart:** 4 stat cards in a grid — New MRR · Expansion · Contraction · Churned — each with mini-sparkline and MoM delta.
198	**Interactions:** Click-drag on chart to zoom time range. Double-click to reset. Click tooltip → opens drawer with that day's subscription events.
199	
200	Library: Recharts (already in Stack A, Sprint 7 chose it) — NOT Chart.js (canvas-based, less composable).

1	# InkOS — 12-Sprint Production-Grade UI/UX Hardening Program
2	
3	## Context
4	
5	InkOS has 73 authenticated pages, 13 public pages, 5 admin pages, 31 shadcn primitives, 255 domain components, and 200+ design tokens. Functionally complete, visually inconsistent. The audit surfaced 11 weakness areas: dark mode untested, loading states minimal (only 3 skeletons across 80+ components), error boundaries violate logger contract, mobile calendar broken, empty states ~50% covered, heading weight inconsistent, focus indicators unverified, color contrast unchecked in dark, no page transitions, calendar + consent builder desktop-only, no centralized Logo component.
6	
7	**Goal:** Ship a product that a customer would mistake for Linear, Stripe, or Attio. Every pixel intentional. Every state handled. Every breakpoint graceful. Every interaction < 200ms perceived. Zero console errors in production.
8	
9	**Execution model:** 12 sprints, each 6-10 autonomous hours. Total program: **95-115 hours** of agent work. Runnable in long blocks (5-10 hours per session) with agent coordination and explicit quality gates.
10	
11	---
12	
13	## Competitive Benchmarks (the bar we're clearing)
14	
15	| Pattern | Primary benchmark | Secondary |
16	|---|---|---|
17	| Dashboard + KPI cards | **Linear** home, **Stripe** dashboard | Vercel, Cron |
18	| Calendar | **Cal.com**, **Fantastical** | Google Calendar |
